query:
MATCH p = ALL TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Generated independently from the public q_trail prompt and current query skill references. ALL TRAIL preserves all edge-distinct paths with repeated nodes allowed; projection retains duplicate lists and path order. Statically reviewed; no database execution.
